_comment: Per-collection display rules for the paper bioassay renderers (mamey/bioassay_paper.py, tools/bioassay_a0*.R). Collection names live here, not in code. A user may pass their own file with --layout-config. Keys: focal_group: roster group drawn by genus in A01 (other groups drawn as one row each; null = all rows by genus). a06_subset_group: roster group A06 is restricted to (null = all). split_larvae: keep the two P. larvae strains apart in A02. group_axis_label: A02 y-axis title. unassigned_label: display text for genus 'Unassigned'. plain_rows: row names drawn in plain type and placed last in A01. a03_genus_keep: genera kept by name in A03 (others become 'Other genera'; null = keep all). a03_source_shape / a04_source_shape: show the source-group shape legend. a02_width_in, a03_height_in: print sizes (in). a04_pool_candida: draw A04 as one Candida axis (the higher of C. albicans, C. auris and species-not-recorded per isolate) even when split_candida splits A01. a04_candida_axis_label: the Candida name on that axis (default Candida sp.). tree_pool_candida: placement-tree activity strips show one pooled Candida column (the strongest recorded state across species) instead of one column per species. print_width_in: the paper text column the figures are drawn for (inches; default 7.2). a04_point_size, a04_text_pt, a04_axis_ticks, a04_height_in: A04 point size (mm), text size (pt), an axis line with ticks, and print height (in; default 5.8). a04_label_column: set the labels of the low corner (both values under 35%) in one column with leader lines.

a01_drop_targets: C. albicans or C. auris (not recorded)
